notes.title: Now Available - Foreign Legion: Multi Massacre
notes.content:
Foreign Legion: Multi Massacre is now available on Steam!

In the sequel to Foreign Legion: Buckets of Blood, you take the role of a Legionnaire to shred a huge army of non-descriptive cannon fodder to lots and lots of pieces. Starting with 3 maps with different game modes, cut down a wide variety of enemies, including peace doves and dolphins.

notes.title: Foreign Legion: Buckets of Blood Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Foreign Legion: Buckets of Blood have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

- Enabled Steam Cloud support
